reviews.text: Paul's tree service in mt. Holly springs did an a fantastic job on trimming my two large trees in my front yard, very reasonable price, I would recommend for your tree service needs.
reviews.author: Shane R.

reviews.text: Hired Paul's to remove a huge dying willow tree, far bigger than I could tackle..they came and did a very professional job, cleaned up all the remnants after and the price was reasonable.Glad I hired them
reviews.author: Jeffrey D.

reviews.text: Contacted Ben a month and a half ago about two fairly simple trees that needed removed - and one that was extremely challenging. The price was more than competitive so awarded them the job. Ben communicated clearly how they would do the project.
reviews.author: D.B. F.
